dataset_name: SAP-Inspired Analytical Pharmaceutical OPEX Dataset (J&J FP&A Aligned)
terminology_disclaimer: Driver-based synthetic OPEX generator producing an SAP-inspired analytical Universal Journal. KSL_BUDGET_FX is an analytical constant-FX extension, dim_fx_rates abstracts SAP TCURR/TCURF/TCURX, and dim_cost_center.WERKS is an analytical plant link (standard SAP CSKS has no WERKS column). Synthetic structural equations generate realistic spend patterns and do not establish empirical causality.

entity_cardinality.WERKS_to_BUKRS: N:1 (6 plants -> 3 company codes via T001W/T001K)
entity_cardinality.BUKRS_to_WAERS: 1:1 in this 3-entity dataset (N:1 in multi-entity SAP systems)

scenario_definitions.BASE: Deterministic projection from 2025-12-31 realized state + FY26 FORWARD_CURVE FX + scheduled milestones.
scenario_definitions.HIRING_FREEZE_Q2: PLANNED_HIRES = 0 from M4-M12 + smooth 0.9%/month natural attrition on ACTIVE_FTE & FIELD_SALES_REPS.
scenario_definitions.PHASE3_DELAY_1Q: Q2 (M4-M6) enrollment/site pause held flat near M3 + 3-month shifted ramp M7-M12 + milestones pushed +3 months.
scenario_definitions.USD_STRENGTHEN_10PCT: Operational drivers identical to BASE; FX_EUR_USD and FX_INR_USD multiplied by 0.90 (-10%).
scenario_definitions.LAUNCH_ACCEL: PRODUCT_LAUNCH_FLAG = 1 and +30% HCP_EVENTS_COUNT across Immunology Commercial_SGA in M3-M9.
